# CANARY-TITLE Cited

CANARY-BODY Belongs to `docs` but cites two other sources at a pin, so its path reaches their stale groups as cited only.[^CANARY-FOOTNOTE] One source cannot diff contents, so the path also keys the changed paths it cites.[^CANARY-FOOTNOTE-plain] A citation naming no revision puts the page and the footnote id in `unpinned`.[^CANARY-FOOTNOTE-unpinned]
